newsitem.title: USA: PRI Automation names Stephen Allison CFO.
newsitem.headline: PRI Automation names Stephen Allison CFO.

text.p: PRI Automation Inc Thursday said it named Stephen Allison, previously chief financial officer at Helix Corp, as its chief financial officer. He will replace John Schickling, who has resigned to pursue other interests.
PRI also said it named Robert Klimm as vice president, operations, replacing Steve Avedikian, who also left PRI to pursue other interests. Klimm joins PRI from Eaton Corp.
PRI is a supplier of factory automation systems that serve the needs of large, mid-sized and specialty semiconductor manufacturers and the flat panel display industry.
